ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: IP address of the Airobot ventilation unit. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the unit.

modbusUnitId.title: Modbus Unit ID
modbusUnitId.description: Modbus slave/unit id used for requests. Defaults to 1.

modbusTrace.title: Enable Modbus Trace Logging
modbusTrace.description: Logs Modbus connection details and raw request/response hex frames to Homebridge logs (info and debug levels).
